direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Refit the inspector so both evidence cards and the primary action fit within 768px without a nested clipped scroll region; compress the mission metrics row before reducing type.
Enlarge SVG labels for MAT-ALLOY-A, CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2 to 11px minimum and raise silverDim contrast on the dark stage.
Link the 120 and 80 tracks bidirectionally to their evidence cards so focus or pointer on either side shows the same neon outline and text label.

Keep ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate headed sections with independent status lines; label the first as nonce and identity health only and the second as the evidence task only.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the route select and ensure its disabled and enabled states are announced as text, not colour alone.
Shorten the lower explanatory panel to one status sentence so the stage gains height at 1366x768.
Preserve the flow where selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; keep the exact phrase, typed count and disabled Accept state visible without scrolling.
Enlarge the option-card radio targets to at least 36px and show Selected path with marker plus text in addition to the neon border.
Align 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 in tabular columns so tradeoffs scan vertically.
Make the header count read clearly as blocked prior tasks and proposed tasks for this state, and keep PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL attached to each of t1, t2 and t3.
Refit the task list so all three proposals and Decline proposal are visible at 768px, retaining internal scroll only as overflow protection.
Clarify the stage route labels 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 with larger type and a direct 40+30=70 units caption.
Strengthen the PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE treatment on CELL-MILL-2 with hatch plus text while reserving full stoppedRed for the applied stopped state.
Keep the warning Will invalidate acceptance adjacent to the machine select and repeat it in the DecisionBar centre status, as currently framed.
Give the machine select a visible focus ring and a 40px target height to match the rail controls.
Retain stoppedRed only on CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; check that the red HOLD label at Receiving does not compete with that exception.
Keep pre-flight route health for nonce and identity separate from the investigation evidence task, with the Reinvestigate recovery primary tied only to the evidence task.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained in the SVG with hatch and text, and remove any feasible neon route through CELL-MILL-2.
Keep the revised typed consent form fully visible with exact phrase, 0/27 typed state and disabled Accept revised decision until the phrase matches.
Show the constrained Split card as unavailable with hatch, text reason and no selectable radio target, while the two feasible paths remain comparable.
Reinforce PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in both inspector and DecisionBar so the fresh review requirement is unmissable.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visibly grouped separately from the 3 proposed replacement tasks marked UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL, with the approved revised plan stated in the DecisionBar.
Refit the board so the blocked group, first replacement task and Approve revised tasks are all readable at 768px without the list cutting mid-card.
Enlarge the small blocked-task text to 11px minimum and use marker plus text, not colour alone, for Blocked versus Proposed.
Sequence Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet and Retain independent checkpoint as numbered, mutually gated steps and show which control is currently enabled in text.
Compress the duplicated passphrase guidance into one checklist line so the third retention step is visible without inspector scrolling at 768px.
Label the 70, 35h and 48h before-after metrics explicitly so the proven recovery figures are understood at a glance.
Replace the duplicate primary-style Verify ledger emphasis in the completed state with Complete text states, leaving Back as the only prominent action in the DecisionBar.
Keep PACKET SEALED - 18 events - revised plan accepted - CELL-MILL-2 offline retained as the single completion sentence and ensure it fits one line at 1366px.
Confirm the completed rail item uses check marker plus text and aria-current, with the official logo appearing only in header and opening story placements.
